What I take care of

When you hand someone the keys to a place you care about, you want to know who's looking after it. Here's what that looks like.

  • Marketing & listing

    I write the listing in plain words, show your place honestly, and get it in front of people on Vashon, starting right here on this site.

  • Tenant screening

    I talk with every applicant, check references, and screen carefully, so the keys go to someone I'd be glad to have next door.

  • Leases done properly

    A clear written lease, filled in right and signed right. At Courthouse Square I post the standard lease in the open, so everyone can read it first.

  • Rent & monthly statements

    I collect the rent and send you a clear statement every month: what came in, what went out, and where things stand.

  • Maintenance with island vendors

    When something needs fixing, I call people on the island I know and trust, and I tell you what's happening before you have to ask.

  • Regular walk-throughs

    I walk your property on a regular schedule, so a small drip gets caught before it turns into a big repair.

Storefronts and homes, both

How it works

No sales pitch and no pressure. Just neighbors talking about a place on the island.

  1. 1

    Say hello

    Tell me about your property in the note below. A few lines is plenty. I read every one myself.

  2. 2

    Walk the property together

    I'll come take a look with you. I want to see the place, and hear what matters to you about it.

  3. 3

    Agree on the details

    We talk through how I'd look after it and what you'd like from me, and we put it in writing, plainly. Questions are welcome at every step.

  4. 4

    I take it from there

    I get it listed, find the right tenant, and handle the day-to-day. You get a clear statement every month.

Tell me about your property.

Where it is, what it is, and what you're hoping for. A few lines is plenty. I read every note myself and will write back within a few business days.

Every place is different, so I'd rather hear about yours than hand you a one-size-fits-all package.

I don't share your contact information. Ever.

Or just email me — me@ebberry.com.
